mapper.insert: insert into basket_match_exception_audit (application_id, match_id, audit_action, before_status, after_status, operator_id, operator_name, audit_remark, reject_reason, create_time, update_time, is_delete) values (#{applicationId}, #{matchId}, #{auditAction}, #{beforeStatus}, #{afterStatus}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, #{auditRemark}, #{rejectReason}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{isDelete})
mapper.select: select * from basket_match_exception_audit where application_id = #{applicationId} and is_delete = 0 order by create_time desc, id desc
